anne: uploaded a tiny internal RN blurb in the doc. goal: 2 bullets + single CTA. can someone quick-review?
liam: quick read. add rollback gates as specific numbers so ops can act.
docs-bot: propose text: 'Internal: rolling canary for batching tuning. Expected ~12% p99 reduction for short sessions. Monitor canary for 25m. Rollback if p99 >25% vs baseline OR errors >1.5% for 3m OR CPU >80% for 3m. Model pinned to model/redwood-realtime:2026-03-21-quant-v2; fallback: 2026-02-09-fast. Ops oncall: @ops-oncall.'
ops-oncall: good. please add deploybot tag `deploybot:tag=rn_pin_0321,quiet_window=00:25` so the bot links this snippet.
anne: added tag and pinned snippet to internal announce thread. can someone start a 5% canary with that model tag?
liam: kicking off canary now. note: ignore transient spikes under 90s during warmup.
deploy-bot: Canary started:
```
canary id: cb-20260321-99
model: model/redwood-realtime:2026-03-21-quant-v2
percent: 5%
start_ts: 1837002050
```
ops-oncall: watching dashboards. will post +12m and +25m health updates.
liam: prepping public microcopy ready to publish if +25m is green.
ops-oncall: 12m health: p95 -8%, p99 -11%, errors 0.4%, cpu 60% — healthy.
anne: thanks — holding for +25m then will push public RN.
ops-oncall: 25m summary: metrics stable, no gates hit. rolling to remainder per plan. anne: go ahead with public blurb.
anne: posted public microcopy and closing thread. thanks all!
